title: Design a Banking Application
description: Model bank accounts, transactions, transfers, and balance tracking.

data.text: Design a banking application with accounts (savings, checking), deposits, withdrawals, transfers between accounts, and transaction history.

data.title: Account and Transaction
Thread Safety
data.text: Bank accounts are shared resources. In a real system, use database transactions with isolation levels (SERIALIZABLE for transfers) to prevent race conditions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Account is the aggregate root for all money operations
Transaction records every state change for audit
Enum AccountType drives interest and fee rules
data.takeaway: Banking is a ledger problem. Every dollar movement is a transaction. Keep accounts as the single source of truth for balance.
